classification: PROTOCOL DEFECT, recorded rather than repaired silently
finding: The original Phase 0 protocol specified terminal outcome, score/win margin, and Monte-Carlo return as recorded quantities but failed to designate the scorer regression target. Before scorer fitting and before any held-out access, training-only target diagnostics revealed that shaped Monte-Carlo return is not aligned with the strategic payoff ordering Gate 0A and SPPPO are designed to preserve. Phase 0 is therefore formally marked UNDER-SPECIFIED at the scorer-target boundary. A prospective amendment designates terminal win margin as the sole Q_psi regression target on construct-validity grounds. No scorer has been fitted and no held-out data have been accessed.

where_the_gap_is.what_was_specified: the scorer FORM Q_psi(o,a1,a2,p), the analytic expectation, the continuation semantics, the branching mechanism, and both gates
where_the_gap_is.why_it_escaped_the_freeze: the form/expectation/continuation amendments were written to close structural holes in the scorer's INPUTS and in state coverage. The target was referred to only as 'G_A'/'G_B' and read as self-evident. It was not.

diagnostic_provenance.bootstrap: by seed, rng 7, n_boot 20000, alpha 0.05 -- same procedure as Gate 0B
diagnostic_provenance.orientation: positive = the strategically appropriate teacher for that pole is favoured

supporting.non_monotone: mean return at margin 0 is -5.270 but at margin +1 is -5.411; the shaped return is not monotone in payoff

diagnostic_provenance.plain_english: the strategically correct teacher earns HIGHER payoff but LOWER shaped Monte-Carlo return

why_this_is_recorded_as_a_defect_and_not.hazard: the choice was made AFTER training-only diagnostics showed which candidate carries the signal. That resembles the prohibited pattern 'changed estimator'.
why_it_is_formally_distinct: no Q_psi exists; nothing has been fitted
Gate 0B has not been run and its 96 held-out seeds have never been opened
the choice is logically PRIOR to any gate evaluation, not a re-scoring of a completed one
no gate, threshold, confidence procedure or effect floor is altered
why_this_is_recorded_as_a_defect_and_not.why_the_record_exists_anyway: the resemblance is close enough that the honest move is to document it. An unusually clean experimental record is worth more than the appearance of never having drafted a protocol imperfectly.
why_this_is_recorded_as_a_defect_and_not.target_independent_argument: every gate in this program -- Gate 0A, the EXP1 crossover, delta_pool -- is defined on PAYOFF. Shaped Monte-Carlo return is a training-time optimisation signal containing reward shaping. Regressing Q_psi on it would build a shaped-reward critic and then ask it to reproduce a payoff ordering its own target opposes. That is a construct-validity failure, and the argument does not depend on the diagnostic above.

what_this_does_NOT_license: changing the 160/96 split, the seed block, or the bootstrap unit
revisiting Gate 0A, which is frozen and passed
growing the dataset if Gate 0B fails (DATA_GROWTH_AFTER_FAILURE remains PROHIBITED)
selecting a different target later if win margin fails Gate 0B
